primary.why: these are NOT ports, they are three different games. (1) The 1994 PS1 original is JAPAN-ONLY and is the game the Western renumbering hides. (2) King's Field Mobile (2004) is a RETELLING with DIFFERENT MAP LAYOUTS, quicksaving and an auto-map. (3) King's Field EX is enhanced again: expanded dungeons, NEW monsters, weapons and armour, new dungeon layouts and one-way doors. Each holds content the others do not ALL THREE. Both keitai versions were preserved AND English-translated in 2025, so they are genuinely playable.

emulation.notes: Whichever release is chosen, PCSX2 patch or PPSSPP patch.

primary.version: Armored Core: Formula Front, PSP / PS2
primary.why: the content is split across two releases. The US PSP version ('Extreme Battle') was MODIFIED to let you actually pilot the mech yourself (the 'N-uAC'), which the Japanese original does not offer. 'International' is that American build re-released in Japan PLUS a large amount of additional battles, the fullest PSP edition. Separately, the PS2 build has MORE MAPS and better AI and never came to North America. BOTH: International for the piloting and extra battles, PS2 for the maps and AI.

BOTH.
